ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels. Darker pixels are concentrated centrally and along the leading edges, while lighter pixels dominate the distal lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark pigmentation core extending from the peduncle into the inner lobes. Transition to high-intensity white zones on the outer 40 percent of each lobe. Distinct black linear and mottled clusters overlaid on the white distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 145 degrees; notch depth is roughly 5 percent of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring high-frequency serrations (peaks and valleys) of 2-5 pixel amplitude. Several larger, more pronounced jagged indentations are visible on the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the upper/outer boundaries, tapering to sharp points at the distal tips; symmetrical upward sweep relative to the central axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of dark circular pixels on the high-intensity white zones of both the left and right distal tips, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral surfaces. The left lobe exhibits 3-4 parallel diagonal lines, while the right lobe shows a complex web of overlapping linear marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks visible as dark linear scars against the white background; prominent diagonal scar near the right lobe tip and irregular pigmentation gaps on the trailing edge serrations.
